component.name: Collapsible
component.description: Expandable content section with optional height transitions.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Container that owns the trigger and expandable content state.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Button users activate to toggle the content visibility.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Region that is mounted for the expanded collapsible content.

own.name: children
own.description: Content to render inside the collapsible.

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: defaultOpen
own.description: Whether the collapsible is open by default (uncontrolled).

own.name: id
own.description: Unique identifier for the collapsible root element.

own.name: onOpenChange
own.description: Callback when the open state changes.

own.name: ref
own.type: JSX.HTMLElementTags["div"] extends { ref?: infer Ref; } ? Ref : never | undefined

own.name: transition
own.description: Whether to keep content mounted until its height transition completes.

own.name: triggerRender
own.description: Custom trigger renderer. Spread `triggerProps` onto the interactive trigger element.
